                                nans = bool(kw.value.value)
                        is_float = _is_float_or_numeric_expr(node.func.value, schema)
                        if nans and is_float:
                            expr = obj_expr.fill_nan(val_expr).fill_null(val_expr)
                        else:
                            expr = obj_expr.fill_null(val_expr)
                    return expr.over(by) if by else expr
                elif attr_name == "cast" and len(node.args) >= 1:
                    target_dt = _extract_dtype_from_ast(node.args[0])
                    expr = obj_expr.cast(target_dt)
                    return expr.over(by) if by else expr

        # 2. Functional map(...)
        if func_name == "map" and len(node.args) >= 2:
            col_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[0], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            mapping_node = node.args[1]
            if isinstance(mapping_node, ast.Dict):
                mapping: dict[Any, Any] = {}
                for k_node, v_node in zip(mapping_node.keys, mapping_node.values):
                    if k_node is not None and isinstance(k_node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(v_node, ast.Constant):
                        mapping[k_node.value] = v_node.value
                    elif k_node is not None:
                        mapping[ast.literal_eval(k_node)] = ast.literal_eval(v_node)
            else:
                mapping = ast.literal_eval(mapping_node)

            default_node = None
            if len(node.args) > 2:
                default_node = node.args[2]
            else:
                for kw in node.keywords:
                    if kw.arg == "default":
                        default_node = kw.value
                        break

            if default_node is not None:
                default_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(default_node, col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            else:
                default_expr = pl.lit(None)

            if hasattr(pl.Expr, "replace_strict"):
                expr = col_expr.replace_strict(mapping, default=default_expr)
            else:
                expr = col_expr.replace(mapping, default=default_expr)  # type: ignore[call-arg]
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr

        # 3. case_when
        if func_name == "case_when":
            if not node.args and not node.keywords:
                raise ValueError("case_when expects at least one (condition, value) pair")
            default_expr = pl.lit(None)
            for kw in node.keywords:
                if kw.arg == "default":
                    default_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(kw.value, col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            pairs: list[tuple[pl.Expr, pl.Expr]] = []
            has_tuple = any(isinstance(a, ast.Tuple) for a in node.args)
            if has_tuple:
                for i, a in enumerate(node.args):
                    if isinstance(a, ast.Tuple) and len(a.elts) == 2:
                        c = _ast_to_polars_expr(a.elts[0], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
                        v = _ast_to_polars_expr(a.elts[1], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
                        pairs.append((c, v))
                    elif i == len(node.args) - 1:
                        default_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(a, col_names, col_map, by, schema)
                    else:
                        raise ValueError("case_when default (non-tuple) must be the last argument")
            else:
                flat_args = list(node.args)
                if len(flat_args) % 2 == 1:
                    default_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(flat_args.pop(), col_names, col_map, by, schema)
                for i in range(0, len(flat_args), 2):
                    c = _ast_to_polars_expr(flat_args[i], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
                    v = _ast_to_polars_expr(flat_args[i + 1], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
                    pairs.append((c, v))

            if not pairs:
                raise ValueError("case_when expects at least one (condition, value) pair")

            any_str = any(
                (
                    isinstance(a, ast.Tuple)
                    and len(a.elts) == 2
                    and isinstance(a.elts[1], ast.Constant)
                    and isinstance(a.elts[1].value, str)
                )
                for a in node.args
            ) or any(isinstance(a, ast.Constant) and isinstance(a.value, str) for a in node.args)
            if any_str:
                pairs = [(c, v.cast(pl.String) if hasattr(v, "cast") else v) for c, v in pairs]
                if hasattr(default_expr, "cast"):
                    default_expr = default_expr.cast(pl.String)

            first_c, first_v = pairs[0]
            when_chain = pl.when(first_c).then(first_v)
            for c, v in pairs[1:]:
                when_chain = when_chain.when(c).then(v)
            expr = when_chain.otherwise(default_expr)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr

        # 5. if_else
        if func_name == "if_else":
            if len(node.args) != 3:
                raise TypeError(
                    f"if_else requires exactly 3 arguments (condition, if_true, if_false), got {len(node.args)}"
                )
            c = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[0], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            t = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[1], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            f = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[2], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            if (isinstance(node.args[1], ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.args[1].value, str)) or (
                isinstance(node.args[2], ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.args[2].value, str)
            ):
                t = t.cast(pl.String) if hasattr(t, "cast") else t
                f = f.cast(pl.String) if hasattr(f, "cast") else f
            expr = pl.when(c).then(t).otherwise(f)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr

        args = [_ast_to_polars_expr(a, col_names, col_map, by, schema) for a in node.args]

        agg_map = {
            "sum": lambda e: e.sum(),
            "mean": lambda e: e.mean(),
            "median": lambda e: e.median(),
            "min": lambda e: e.min(),
            "max": lambda e: e.max(),
            "std": lambda e: e.std(),
            "var": lambda e: e.var(),
            "rank": lambda e: e.rank(),
        }
        if func_name in agg_map and len(args) == 1:
            expr = agg_map[func_name](args[0])
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("len", "count") and len(args) <= 1:
            expr = pl.len()
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name == "shift" and len(args) >= 1:
            shift_n = 1
            if len(node.args) > 1:
                arg1 = node.args[1]
                if isinstance(arg1, ast.Constant) and isinstance(arg1.value, (int, float)):
                    shift_n = int(arg1.value)
                elif (
                    isinstance(arg1, ast.UnaryOp)
                    and isinstance(arg1.op, ast.USub)
                    and isinstance(arg1.operand, ast.Constant)
                ):
                    shift_n = -int(arg1.operand.value)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            expr = args[0].shift(shift_n)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name == "lead" and len(args) >= 1:
            shift_val = node.args[1].value if len(node.args) > 1 and isinstance(node.args[1], ast.Constant) else 1
            shift_n = int(shift_val) if isinstance(shift_val, (int, float)) else 1
            expr = args[0].shift(-shift_n)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name == "lag" and len(args) >= 1:
            shift_val = node.args[1].value if len(node.args) > 1 and isinstance(node.args[1], ast.Constant) else 1
            shift_n = int(shift_val) if isinstance(shift_val, (int, float)) else 1
            expr = args[0].shift(shift_n)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name == "round":
            dec_val = node.args[1].value if len(node.args) > 1 and isinstance(node.args[1], ast.Constant) else 0
            dec = int(dec_val) if isinstance(dec_val, (int, float)) else 0
            return args[0].round(dec)
        if func_name == "abs" and len(args) == 1:
            return args[0].abs()
        if func_name == "sqrt" and len(args) == 1:
            return args[0].sqrt()
        if func_name == "log" and len(args) == 1:
            return args[0].log()
        if func_name == "exp" and len(args) == 1:
            return args[0].exp()
        if func_name == "floor" and len(args) == 1:
            return args[0].floor()
        if func_name == "ceil" and len(args) == 1:
            return args[0].ceil()
        if func_name == "coalesce":
            return pl.coalesce(args)
        if func_name == "fillna" and len(node.args) >= 2:
            target_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[0], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            val_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[1], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            nans = True
            if len(node.args) > 2 and isinstance(node.args[2], ast.Constant):
                nans = bool(node.args[2].value)
            for kw in node.keywords:
                if kw.arg == "nans" and isinstance(kw.value, ast.Constant):
                    nans = bool(kw.value.value)
            is_float = _is_float_or_numeric_expr(node.args[0], schema)
            if nans and is_float:
                expr = target_expr.fill_nan(val_expr).fill_null(val_expr)
            else:
                expr = target_expr.fill_null(val_expr)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name == "fill_null" and len(node.args) >= 2:
            target_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[0], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            val_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[1], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            expr = target_expr.fill_null(val_expr)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name == "fill_nan" and len(node.args) >= 2:
            target_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[0], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            val_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[1], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            expr = target_expr.fill_nan(val_expr)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name == "n" and len(args) == 0:
            expr = pl.len()
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("int", "int64", "i64") and len(args) == 1:
            expr = args[0].cast(pl.Int64)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("int32", "i32") and len(args) == 1:
            expr = args[0].cast(pl.Int32)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("int16", "i16") and len(args) == 1:
            expr = args[0].cast(pl.Int16)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("int8", "i8") and len(args) == 1:
            expr = args[0].cast(pl.Int8)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("uint64", "u64") and len(args) == 1:
            expr = args[0].cast(pl.UInt64)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("uint32", "u32") and len(args) == 1:
            expr = args[0].cast(pl.UInt32)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("float", "float64", "f64") and len(args) == 1:
            expr = args[0].cast(pl.Float64)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("float32", "f32") and len(args) == 1:
            expr = args[0].cast(pl.Float32)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("str", "string") and len(args) == 1:
            expr = args[0].cast(pl.String)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name in ("bool", "boolean") and len(args) == 1:
            expr = args[0].cast(pl.Boolean)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr
        if func_name == "cast" and len(node.args) == 2:
            target_expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(node.args[0], col_names, col_map, by, schema)
            target_dt = _extract_dtype_from_ast(node.args[1])
            expr = target_expr.cast(target_dt)
            return expr.over(by) if by else expr

    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported AST node: {type(node)}")


def mutate_polars(
    df: pl.DataFrame,
    parsed_spec: dict[str, Any],
    by: list[str] | None = None,
    params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    dropna: bool = False,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Evaluate mutate expressions on a Polars DataFrame using native Polars vectorization."""
    cur = df
    for raw_col, raw_val in parsed_spec.items():
        cur_cols = set(_df_columns(cur))
        m_multi = re.match(r"^([^()]*)\(([^()]*)\)([^()]*)$", raw_col)
        if m_multi and isinstance(raw_val, str) and raw_col not in cur_cols:
            prefix, inner_spec, suffix = m_multi.groups()
            target_cols = _resolve_multi_target_cols(cur, inner_spec, by)
            expanded_pairs = [
                (f"{prefix}{tc}{suffix}", _replace_underscore_placeholder(raw_val, tc)) for tc in target_cols
            ]
        else:
            expanded_pairs = [(raw_col, raw_val)]

        for col_name, val in expanded_pairs:
            if not isinstance(val, str):
                cur = cur.with_columns(pl.lit(val).alias(col_name))
                continue

            expr_str = val.strip()
            if "@" in expr_str:
                _, at_tokens = _strip_at_refs(expr_str)
                for var_name in at_tokens:
                    if params and var_name in params:
                        val_p = params[var_name]
                        expr_str = re.sub(rf"@{var_name}\b", repr(val_p), expr_str)
                    else:
                        all_avail = list(params.keys()) if params else []
                        import difflib

                        close = difflib.get_close_matches(var_name, all_avail, n=1)
                        hint = f" (did you mean '@{close[0]}'?)" if close else ""
                        raise KeyError(f"local variable '@{var_name}' is not defined{hint}")

            cur_cols = set(_df_columns(cur))
            safe_expr, col_map = _rewrite_fallback_col_refs(expr_str, cur_cols)
            try:
                parsed = ast.parse(safe_expr, mode="eval")
                expr = _ast_to_polars_expr(parsed, cur_cols, col_map, by=by, schema=_df_schema(cur))
                if dropna and by:
                    null_mask = pl.any_horizontal([pl.col(c).is_null() for c in by])
                    expr = pl.when(null_mask).then(pl.lit(None)).otherwise(expr)
                cur = cur.with_columns(expr.alias(col_name))
            except (pl.exceptions.InvalidOperationError, pl.exceptions.ComputeError) as exc:
                msg = str(exc).lower()
                if any(
                    term in msg
                    for term in (
                        "unsupported",
                        "cannot",
                        "arithmetic",
                        "operator",
                        "divide",
                        "division",
                        "add",
                        "sub",
                        "mul",
                    )
                ):
                    raise TypeError(str(exc)) from exc
                raise
    return cur


def pick_polars(
    df: pl.DataFrame,
    col: str,
    n: int | None = None,
    prop: float | None = None,
    order: str = "max",
    with_ties: bool = False,
    na_last: bool = True,
    by: list[str] | None = None,
) -> Any:
    """Select the rows with the largest (or smallest) values of a column, optionally grouped by 'by'."""
    clean_col = _unquote_name(col.strip())
    df_cols = _df_columns(df)
    if clean_col not in df_cols:
        raise KeyError(f"pick: column '{clean_col}' not found in DataFrame. Available columns: {df_cols}")

    if n is not None and prop is not None:
        raise ValueError("pick: specify either 'n' or 'prop', not both")

    if n is None and prop is None:
        n = 1

    clean_order = order.strip().lower() if isinstance(order, str) else "max"
    if clean_order not in ("max", "min"):
        raise ValueError(f"pick: order must be 'max' or 'min', got {order!r}")
    is_desc = clean_order == "max"

    if prop is not None:
        if not (0 < prop <= 1):
            raise ValueError(f"pick: 'prop' must be between 0 and 1, got {prop}")

    if by:
        unknown_by = [c for c in by if c not in df_cols]
        if unknown_by:
            raise KeyError(f"pick: grouping column(s) {unknown_by} not found in DataFrame")

        sort_cols = by + [clean_col]
        sort_desc = [False] * len(by) + [is_desc]
        sorted_df = df.sort(sort_cols, descending=sort_desc, nulls_last=na_last)

        if prop is not None:
            valid_cnt = pl.col(clean_col).drop_nulls().len().over(by)
            cutoff = (valid_cnt * prop).floor().cast(pl.Int64).clip(lower_bound=1)
            if with_ties:
                rank_expr = pl.col(clean_col).rank(method="min", descending=is_desc).over(by)
                return sorted_df.filter(rank_expr <= cutoff)
            row_nr = pl.int_range(1, pl.len() + 1).over(by)
            return sorted_df.filter(row_nr <= cutoff)

        assert n is not None
        if n <= 0:
            return df.head(0)
        if with_ties:
            rank_expr = pl.col(clean_col).rank(method="min", descending=is_desc).over(by)
            return sorted_df.filter(rank_expr <= n)
        return sorted_df.group_by(by, maintain_order=True).head(n)

    sorted_df = df.sort(clean_col, descending=is_desc, nulls_last=na_last)
    if prop is not None:
        cnt_expr = sorted_df.select(pl.col(clean_col).drop_nulls().len())
        valid_cnt = cnt_expr.collect().item() if isinstance(cnt_expr, pl.LazyFrame) else cnt_expr.item()
        k = max(1, int(valid_cnt * prop))
        if with_ties:
            return sorted_df.filter(pl.col(clean_col).rank(method="min", descending=is_desc) <= k)
        return sorted_df.head(k)

    assert n is not None
    if n <= 0:
        return df.head(0)
    if with_ties:
        return sorted_df.filter(pl.col(clean_col).rank(method="min", descending=is_desc) <= n)
    return sorted_df.head(n)


def value_counts_polars(
    df: Any,
    cols: list[str] | None = None,
    dropna: bool = False,
) -> Any:
    """Compute value counts across specified or all columns in a Polars DataFrame or LazyFrame."""
    df_cols = _df_columns(df)
    target_cols = cols if cols is not None else df_cols
    if "count" in target_cols and "n" in target_cols:
        raise ValueError(
            "-value_counts: columns contain both 'count' and 'n'; rename one to avoid ambiguous count headers"
        )

    count_name = "count" if "count" not in target_cols else "n"

    work_df = df
    if dropna:
        work_df = work_df.drop_nulls(subset=target_cols)

    return work_df.group_by(target_cols).len().rename({"len": count_name}).sort(count_name, descending=True)


def long_polars(
    df: pl.DataFrame,
    cols: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
    id_vars: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
    c: str = "variable",
    v: str = "value",
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Unpivot a Polars DataFrame from wide to long format."""
    if kwargs:
        raise TypeError(f"long_polars() got unexpected keyword argument(s): {list(kwargs.keys())}")

    all_cols = _df_columns(df)

    def _norm_spec(spec: str | Sequence[str] | None, param_name: str) -> list[str] | None:
        if spec is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(spec, str):
            from pytae._text import tokenize as _tok

            items = [
                _unquote_name(item.strip())
                for item in _tok(spec, ",", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True)
                if item.strip()
            ]
        elif isinstance(spec, (list, tuple, set)):
            items = [_unquote_name(item) if isinstance(item, str) else item for item in spec]
        else:
            raise TypeError(f"{param_name} must be a column name or sequence of names, got {type(spec).__name__}")
        for item in items:
            if item not in all_cols:
                import difflib

                close = difflib.get_close_matches(str(item), [str(col) for col in all_cols], n=1)
                hint = f" (did you mean '{close[0]}'?)" if close else ""
                raise KeyError(f"long(): {param_name} column '{item}' not found in DataFrame{hint}")
        return items

    melt_cols = _norm_spec(cols, "cols")
    keep_ids = _norm_spec(id_vars, "id_vars")

    if melt_cols is not None and keep_ids is not None:
        overlap = set(melt_cols).intersection(keep_ids)
        if overlap:
            raise ValueError(f"long(): column(s) {sorted(overlap)} cannot appear in both 'cols' and 'id_vars'")

    if melt_cols is not None:
        if keep_ids is None:
            keep_ids = [col for col in all_cols if col not in melt_cols]
    elif keep_ids is not None:
        melt_cols = [col for col in all_cols if col not in keep_ids]
        if not melt_cols:
            raise ValueError("long(): no columns left to melt after keeping id_vars")
    else:
        schema = _df_schema(df)
        numeric_cols = [col for col, dtype in schema.items() if dtype.is_numeric()]
        if not numeric_cols:
            raise ValueError(
                "long(): no numeric columns to melt. "
                "Specify columns to melt via cols= (e.g. df.pt.long(cols=['q1', 'q2'])) "
                "or id_vars= (e.g. df.pt.long(id_vars=['id']))."
            )
        melt_cols = numeric_cols
        keep_ids = [col for col in all_cols if col not in melt_cols]

    if c == v:
        raise ValueError(
            f"long(): output variable column 'c' ({c!r}) and value column 'v' ({v!r}) cannot have the same name"
        )
    if c in keep_ids:
        raise ValueError(f"long(): output variable column 'c' ({c!r}) collides with kept id column(s)")
    if v in keep_ids:
        raise ValueError(f"long(): output value column 'v' ({v!r}) collides with kept id column(s)")
    if v in melt_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"long(): output value column 'v' ({v!r}) collides with melted column(s)")

    return df.unpivot(on=melt_cols, index=keep_ids, variable_name=c, value_name=v)


def wide_polars(
    df: Any,
    r: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
    c: str = "variable",
    v: str = "value",
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Reshape a long Polars DataFrame into wide format (1-to-1 pivot)."""
    if isinstance(df, pl.LazyFrame):
        df = df.collect()
    for bad_arg in ("a", "agg", "aggfunc", "dropna"):
        if bad_arg in kwargs:
            raise ValueError(
                f"wide() does not support '{bad_arg}'. wide() is strictly for 1-to-1 reshaping "
                "without aggregation. Use pt.pivot() / -pivot for multi-dimensional aggregation."
            )

    if "index" in kwargs:
        raise TypeError("wide() parameter 'index' has been removed; use 'r' instead")
    if kwargs:
        raise TypeError(f"wide() got unexpected keyword argument(s): {list(kwargs.keys())}; only r, c, v are accepted")

    c = _unquote_name(c)
    if v is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "wide(): value column 'v' cannot be None. Specify the column to spread via v= (e.g. v='value')."
        )
    v = _unquote_name(v)
    if c == v:
        raise ValueError(f"wide(): 'c' and 'v' cannot be the same column ('{c}')")
    if c not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"wide(): columns 'c' column '{c}' not found in DataFrame")
    if v not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"wide(): values 'v' column '{v}' not found in DataFrame")

    if r is not None:
        if isinstance(r, str):
            from pytae._text import tokenize as _tok

            r_cols = [
                _unquote_name(col.strip()) for col in _tok(r, ",", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True) if col.strip()
            ]
        else:
            r_cols = [_unquote_name(col) if isinstance(col, str) else col for col in r]
        for col in r_cols:
            if col not in df.columns:
                raise KeyError(f"wide(): row 'r' column '{col}' not found in DataFrame")
        if c in r_cols:
            raise ValueError(f"wide(): column 'c' ('{c}') cannot also be in row 'r' columns")
        if v is not None and v in r_cols:
            raise ValueError(f"wide(): column 'v' ('{v}') cannot also be in row 'r' columns")
    else:
        r_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in [c, v]]

    distinct_c_vals = set(str(x) for x in df[c].unique().to_list())
    colliding = [col for col in r_cols if str(col) in distinct_c_vals]
    if colliding:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Resetting index failed: index level name(s) {colliding} collide with existing column name(s). "
            "Rename the column or index before resetting."
        )

    try:
        res = df.pivot(
            on=c,
            index=r_cols if r_cols else None,
            values=v,
            sort_columns=True,
        )
        if r_cols:
            res = res.sort(r_cols)
        return res
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            f"wide() encountered duplicate entries for row 'r' {r_cols} and column '{c}'. "
            "wide() is strictly for 1-to-1 reshaping without aggregation. "
            "Use pt.pivot() / -pivot to summarize or aggregate duplicate entries."
        ) from exc


def handle_missing_polars(
    df: Any,
    fillna: str | None = ".",
    numeric_fill: Any = 0,
    cols: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    preserve_categories: bool = True,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> Any:
    """Fill missing values in a Polars DataFrame or LazyFrame with type-appropriate defaults."""
    df_cols = _df_columns(df)
    schema = _df_schema(df)
    target_cols = set(cols) if cols is not None else set(df_cols)
    exprs: list[pl.Expr] = []

    for c in df_cols:
        if c not in target_cols:
            exprs.append(pl.col(c))
            continue

        dtype = schema[c]
        if dtype.is_numeric():
            if numeric_fill == "mean":
                col_expr = pl.col(c).fill_nan(None) if dtype.is_float() else pl.col(c)
                exprs.append(col_expr.fill_null(col_expr.mean()))
            elif numeric_fill == "median":
                col_expr = pl.col(c).fill_nan(None) if dtype.is_float() else pl.col(c)
                exprs.append(col_expr.fill_null(col_expr.median()))
            elif numeric_fill is not None:
                if dtype.is_float():
                    exprs.append(pl.col(c).fill_nan(numeric_fill).fill_null(numeric_fill))
                else:
                    exprs.append(pl.col(c).fill_null(numeric_fill))
            else:
                exprs.append(pl.col(c))
        elif dtype in (pl.String, pl.Null):
            fill_str = str(fillna) if fillna is not None else "."
            exprs.append(pl.col(c).cast(pl.String).fill_null(fill_str).str.strip_chars())
        elif dtype == pl.Categorical:
            fill_str = str(fillna) if fillna is not None else "."
            expr = pl.col(c).cast(pl.String).fill_null(fill_str)
            if preserve_categories:
                expr = expr.cast(pl.Categorical)
            exprs.append(expr)
        else:
            exprs.append(pl.col(c))

    return df.with_columns(exprs)


def replace_values_polars(
    df: Any,
    v: dict[Any, Any],
    c: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
    exact: bool = True,
) -> Any:
    """Replace values in a Polars DataFrame or LazyFrame (exact or substring)."""
    df_cols = _df_columns(df)
    schema = _df_schema(df)
    target_cols = ([c] if isinstance(c, str) else list(c)) if c is not None else list(df_cols)
    if not exact:
        non_string_cols = [col for col in target_cols if schema[col] not in (pl.String, pl.Utf8)]
        if non_string_cols:
            raise ValueError(
                f"replace_values: exact=False (substring match) only works on string/object "
                f"columns; non-string column(s): {non_string_cols}"
            )
        exprs: list[pl.Expr] = []
        for col in df_cols:
            if col in target_cols:
                col_expr = pl.col(col)
                for old_val, new_val in v.items():
                    col_expr = col_expr.str.replace_all(re.escape(str(old_val)), str(new_val))
                exprs.append(col_expr)
            else:
                exprs.append(pl.col(col))
        return df.with_columns(exprs)

    exprs = []
    for col in df_cols:
        if col in target_cols:
            mapping = {k: v_val for k, v_val in v.items()}
            exprs.append(pl.col(col).replace(mapping))
        else:
            exprs.append(pl.col(col))
    return df.with_columns(exprs)


def clean_columns_polars(df: Any, **opts: Any) -> Any:
    """Clean column header names in a Polars DataFrame or LazyFrame."""
    from pytae.other_utilities import clean_column_names

    old_cols = _df_columns(df)
    new_cols = clean_column_names(old_cols, **opts)
    if new_cols == old_cols:
        return df
    if len(set(new_cols)) < len(new_cols):
        raise ValueError("clean_columns resulted in duplicate column names; set dedupe=True to auto-disambiguate")
    mapping = dict(zip(old_cols, new_cols))
    return df.rename(mapping)


def agg_polars(
    df: Any,
    *specs: Any,
    by: list[str] | Sequence[str] | None = None,
    a: Any = None,
    dropna: bool = False,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> Any:
    """Aggregate a Polars DataFrame or LazyFrame by group or across the whole table."""
    if "by" in kwargs or "_by" in kwargs:
        raise TypeError(
            "agg() does not accept 'by'. Set grouping beforehand using pt.by(df, 'col') or df.pt.by('col')."
        )

    if isinstance(a, dict):
        raise TypeError("agg() no longer accepts dictionaries. Use kwargs (col='sum') or strings.")
    for s in specs:
        if isinstance(s, dict):
            raise TypeError("agg() no longer accepts dictionaries. Use kwargs (col='sum') or strings.")

    if a is not None and specs:
        raise TypeError("agg(): multiple values for aggregation spec: both positional args and 'a' were provided")

    if "drop_nulls" in kwargs:
        dropna = kwargs.pop("drop_nulls")
    by_cols: list[str] = list(by) if by else []
    work_df = df
    if by_cols and dropna:
        work_df = work_df.drop_nulls(subset=by_cols)

    exprs: list[pl.Expr] = []
    output_names: list[str] = []

    def _add_expr(e: pl.Expr, name: str) -> None:
        if name in by_cols:
            raise ValueError(f"agg(): output column name '{name}' collides with group column '{name}'")
        if name in output_names:
            raise ValueError(f"agg(): output column name '{name}' is duplicated in aggregation specification")
        output_names.append(name)
        exprs.append(e.alias(name))

    active_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
    remaining_specs: list[Any] = []

    raw_items = list(specs)
    if a is not None:
        if specs:
            raise TypeError("agg(): multiple values for aggregation spec: both positional args and 'a' were provided")
        raw_items = [a] if not isinstance(a, (list, tuple)) else list(a)

    for item in raw_items:
        if isinstance(item, str) and ("=" in item or ":" in item):
            from pytae.cli_parsing import parse_agg

            parsed = parse_agg(item)
            if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                active_kwargs.update(parsed)
            else:
                remaining_specs.append(item)
        else:
            remaining_specs.append(item)

    if kwargs:
        active_kwargs.update(kwargs)

    if "__dropna__" in active_kwargs:
        dropna = active_kwargs.pop("__dropna__")
        if by_cols and dropna:
            work_df = work_df.drop_nulls(subset=by_cols)
    if "drop_nulls" in active_kwargs:
        dropna = active_kwargs.pop("drop_nulls")
        if by_cols and dropna:
            work_df = work_df.drop_nulls(subset=by_cols)
    if "dropna" in active_kwargs:
        dropna = active_kwargs.pop("dropna")
        if by_cols and dropna:
            work_df = work_df.drop_nulls(subset=by_cols)

    if active_kwargs and remaining_specs and specs:
        raise ValueError("agg(): cannot mix whole-frame aggregation with keyword arguments")

    if active_kwargs:
        for out_name, val in active_kwargs.items():
            clean_out = _unquote_name(out_name)
            if val in ("n", "count", "size") or val == ["n"] or val == ("n",):
                if "n" in by_cols and clean_out == "n":
                    raise ValueError("agg(): count 'n' collides with group column 'n'")
                _add_expr(pl.len().cast(pl.Int64), clean_out)
            elif isinstance(val, str) and ":" in val:
                src, fn_str = val.split(":", 1)
                src = _unquote_name(src.strip())
                fn_list = [f.strip() for f in fn_str.split(",") if f.strip()]
                if len(fn_list) > 1:
                    for f in fn_list:
                        _add_expr(_polars_agg_expr(pl.col(src), f), f"{clean_out}_{f}")
                else:
                    _add_expr(_polars_agg_expr(pl.col(src), fn_list[0]), clean_out)
            elif isinstance(val, str):
                fn_list = [f.strip() for f in val.split(",") if f.strip()]
                if len(fn_list) > 1:
                    for f in fn_list:
                        _add_expr(_polars_agg_expr(pl.col(clean_out), f), f"{clean_out}_{f}")
                else:
                    _add_expr(_polars_agg_expr(pl.col(clean_out), fn_list[0]), clean_out)
            elif isinstance(val, (list, tuple)):
                fn_list = list(val)
                if len(fn_list) > 1:
                    for f in fn_list:
                        _add_expr(_polars_agg_expr(pl.col(clean_out), f), f"{clean_out}_{f}")
                else:
                    _add_expr(_polars_agg_expr(pl.col(clean_out), fn_list[0]), clean_out)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"agg(): unsupported kwargs specification {clean_out}={val!r}")
    else:
        items_to_process = remaining_specs if remaining_specs else ["sum"]
        flat_fns: list[str] = []
        for item in items_to_process:
            if isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
                for sub in item:
                    if isinstance(sub, str) and "," in sub:
                        flat_fns.extend([p.strip() for p in sub.split(",") if p.strip()])
                    else:
                        flat_fns.append(str(sub).strip())
            elif isinstance(item, str):
                if "," in item:
                    flat_fns.extend([p.strip() for p in item.split(",") if p.strip()])
                else:
                    flat_fns.append(item.strip())
            else:
                flat_fns.append(str(item).strip())

        known_aggs = {
            "sum",
            "mean",
            "median",
            "min",
            "max",
            "std",
            "var",
            "first",
            "last",
            "n",
            "count",
            "size",
            "nunique",
            "n_unique",
        }
        for fn in flat_fns:
            if fn not in known_aggs:
                raise ValueError(f"agg(): unsupported aggregation function or invalid syntax '{fn}'")

        unique_fns = list(dict.fromkeys(flat_fns))
        has_n = any(f in ("n", "count", "size") for f in unique_fns)
        rem_fns = [f for f in unique_fns if f not in ("n", "count", "size")]
        num_cols = [c for c, dt in _df_schema(work_df).items() if dt.is_numeric() and c not in by_cols]

        if has_n and "n" in num_cols:
            raise ValueError(
                "agg(): cannot compute 'n' (row count) because the input already has a numeric column named 'n'"
            )
        if has_n and "n" in by_cols:
            raise ValueError("agg(): count 'n' collides with group column 'n'")

        if has_n:
            _add_expr(pl.len().cast(pl.Int64), "n")

        for c in num_cols:
            for fn in rem_fns:
                col_name = f"{c}_{fn}" if len(rem_fns) > 1 else c
                _add_expr(_polars_agg_expr(pl.col(c), fn), col_name)

    if not exprs:
        raise ValueError("agg(): no aggregation expressions could be constructed")

    if by_cols:
        res = work_df.group_by(by_cols).agg(exprs).sort(by_cols, nulls_last=True)
    else:
        res = work_df.select(exprs)
    return res


def _to_polars_frame(obj: Any) -> pl.DataFrame | pl.LazyFrame:
    """Convert any tabular input (Pytae DataFrame, Pandas DataFrame, Polars DataFrame/LazyFrame, dict) to Polars."""
    if isinstance(obj, (pl.DataFrame, pl.LazyFrame)):
        return obj
    if hasattr(obj, "_df") and isinstance(obj._df, (pl.DataFrame, pl.LazyFrame)):
        return obj._df
    if hasattr(obj, "to_polars"):
        return obj.to_polars()
    if hasattr(obj, "to_pandas"):
        import pandas as pd

        return pl.from_pandas(obj.to_pandas())
    try:
        import pandas as pd

        if isinstance(obj, pd.DataFrame):
            return pl.from_pandas(obj)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return pl.DataFrame(obj)


def join_polars(
    left: Any,
    other: Any,
    on: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
    how: str = "inner",
    *,
    left_on: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
    right_on: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
    suffix: str = "_right",
    suffixes: tuple[str, str] | None = None,
    validate: str = "m:m",
    coalesce: bool | None = None,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> Any:
    """Join two tabular datasets using Polars multithreaded SIMD vectorization.

    Retains lazy execution plan if both frames are LazyFrames (or converts eager to lazy
    when joining lazy with eager).
    """
    left_pl = _to_polars_frame(left)
    right_pl = _to_polars_frame(other)

    # If one is LazyFrame and other is DataFrame, unify to LazyFrame for lazy execution
    if isinstance(left_pl, pl.LazyFrame) and not isinstance(right_pl, pl.LazyFrame):
        right_pl = right_pl.lazy()
    elif not isinstance(left_pl, pl.LazyFrame) and isinstance(right_pl, pl.LazyFrame):
        left_pl = left_pl.lazy()

    left_cols = _df_columns(left_pl)
    right_cols = _df_columns(right_pl)

    how_norm = str(how).lower()
    if how_norm == "outer":
        how_norm = "full"
    valid_hows = {"inner", "left", "right", "full", "semi", "anti", "cross"}
    if how_norm not in valid_hows:
        raise ValueError(
            f"join(): unsupported join type '{how}'. "
            f"Supported join types: 'inner', 'left', 'right', 'full', 'semi', 'anti', 'cross'."
        )

    def _split_cols(c: str | Sequence[str]) -> list[str]:
        if isinstance(c, str):
            return [x.strip() for x in c.split(",") if x.strip()]
        return [str(x).strip() for x in c if str(x).strip()]

    on_cols: list[str] | None = None
    l_cols_key: list[str] | None = None
    r_cols_key: list[str] | None = None

    if how_norm == "cross":
        if on is not None or left_on is not None or right_on is not None:
            raise ValueError("join(): 'on', 'left_on', and 'right_on' cannot be used with how='cross'")
    elif on is not None:
        if left_on is not None or right_on is not None:
            raise ValueError("join(): Cannot specify both 'on' and 'left_on'/'right_on'")
        raw_items = _split_cols(on)
        has_colon = any(":" in item for item in raw_items)
        if has_colon:
            left_keys = []
            right_keys = []
            for item in raw_items:
                if ":" in item:
                    parts = item.split(":", 1)
                    left_keys.append(parts[0].strip())
                    right_keys.append(parts[1].strip())
                else:
                    left_keys.append(item.strip())
                    right_keys.append(item.strip())
            l_cols_key = left_keys
            r_cols_key = right_keys
        else:
            on_cols = raw_items
    elif left_on is not None or right_on is not None:
        if left_on is None or right_on is None:
            raise ValueError("join(): Both 'left_on' and 'right_on' must be specified")
        l_keys = _split_cols(left_on)
        r_keys = _split_cols(right_on)
        if len(l_keys) != len(r_keys):
            raise ValueError(f"join(): 'left_on' ({len(l_keys)}) and 'right_on' ({len(r_keys)}) must have same length")
        if l_keys == r_keys:
            on_cols = l_keys
        else:
            l_cols_key = l_keys
            r_cols_key = r_keys
    else:
        # Auto-detect common columns
        common = [c for c in left_cols if c in right_cols]
        if not common:
            raise ValueError(
                "join(): No common columns found between left and right tables. "
                "Specify join keys via 'on' or 'left_on'/'right_on'."
            )
        on_cols = common

    # Validate columns
    if on_cols is not None:
        missing_l = [c for c in on_cols if c not in left_cols]
        missing_r = [c for c in on_cols if c not in right_cols]
        if missing_l or missing_r:
            missing_both = list(dict.fromkeys(missing_l + missing_r))
            raise ValueError(f"join(): 'on' column(s) not found in both tables: {missing_both}")
    elif l_cols_key is not None and r_cols_key is not None:
        missing_l = [c for c in l_cols_key if c not in left_cols]
        if missing_l:
            raise ValueError(f"join(): 'left_on' column(s) not found in left table: {missing_l}")
        missing_r = [c for c in r_cols_key if c not in right_cols]
        if missing_r:
            raise ValueError(f"join(): 'right_on' column(s) not found in right table: {missing_r}")

    val_map = {
        "1:1": "1:1",
        "one_to_one": "1:1",
        "1:m": "1:m",
        "one_to_many": "1:m",
        "m:1": "m:1",
        "many_to_one": "m:1",
        "m:m": "m:m",
        "many_to_many": "m:m",
    }
    validate_arg: Any = val_map.get(str(validate).lower(), "m:m")

    eff_suffix = suffix
    if suffixes is not None:
        if not (isinstance(suffixes, (tuple, list)) and len(suffixes) == 2):
            raise ValueError("join(): 'suffixes' must be a tuple or list of two strings, e.g. ('_x', '_y')")
        l_suf, r_suf = suffixes
        if on_cols is not None:
            key_set = set(on_cols)
        elif l_cols_key is not None and r_cols_key is not None:
            key_set = set(l_cols_key) | set(r_cols_key)
        else:
            key_set = set()
        conflicts = [c for c in left_cols if c in right_cols and c not in key_set]
        if conflicts:
            if l_suf:
                left_pl = left_pl.rename({c: f"{c}{l_suf}" for c in conflicts})
            if r_suf:
                right_pl = right_pl.rename({c: f"{c}{r_suf}" for c in conflicts})
        eff_suffix = ""

    if coalesce is not None:
        coalesce_val = coalesce
    elif on_cols is not None or (l_cols_key == r_cols_key):
        coalesce_val = True
    else:
        coalesce_val = False

    if how_norm == "cross":
        return left_pl.join(right_pl, how="cross", suffix=eff_suffix, **kwargs)
    elif on_cols is not None:
        return left_pl.join(
            right_pl,
            on=on_cols,
            how=how_norm,
            suffix=eff_suffix,
            validate=validate_arg,
            coalesce=coalesce_val,
            **kwargs,
        )
    else:
        return left_pl.join(
            right_pl,
            left_on=l_cols_key,
            right_on=r_cols_key,
            how=how_norm,
            suffix=eff_suffix,
            validate=validate_arg,
            coalesce=coalesce_val,
            **kwargs,
        )


def concat_polars(
    items: Sequence[Any],
    how: str = "vertical",
    axis: int | str | None = None,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> Any:
    """Concatenate multiple DataFrames vertically or horizontally with Polars.

    Automatically handles LazyFrames lazily, and falls back to diagonal_relaxed
    if schemas differ in column sets during vertical concatenation.
    """
    if not items:
        raise ValueError("concat(): requires at least one DataFrame")

    pl_dfs = [_to_polars_frame(d) for d in items]
    has_lazy = any(isinstance(d, pl.LazyFrame) for d in pl_dfs)
    if has_lazy:
        pl_dfs = [d.lazy() if not isinstance(d, pl.LazyFrame) else d for d in pl_dfs]

    if axis in (1, "columns", "horizontal") or how == "horizontal":
        # Disambiguate duplicate column names across frames if present
        seen_cols: set[str] = set()
        renamed_dfs = []
        for i, d in enumerate(pl_dfs):
            cols = _df_columns(d)
            clashes = {c: f"{c}_{i}" for c in cols if c in seen_cols}
            if clashes:
                d = d.rename(clashes)
            seen_cols.update(_df_columns(d))
            renamed_dfs.append(d)
        return pl.concat(renamed_dfs, how="horizontal", **kwargs)

    if how in ("diagonal", "diagonal_relaxed"):
        return pl.concat(pl_dfs, how=how, **kwargs)

    try:
        return pl.concat(pl_dfs, how="vertical", **kwargs)
    except (pl.exceptions.SchemaError, pl.exceptions.ShapeError, Exception):
        return pl.concat(pl_dfs, how="diagonal_relaxed", **kwargs)


def cast_polars(
    df: Any,
    dtypes: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None,
    strict: bool = True,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> Any:
    """Cast column data types on a Polars DataFrame or LazyFrame."""
    target_map: dict[str, pl.DataType] = {}
    if dtypes is not None:
        if isinstance(dtypes, str):
            from pytae._text import tokenize as _tok

            tokens = _tok(dtypes, ",", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True)
            for token in tokens:
                token = token.strip()
                if not token:
                    continue
                if ":" in token:
                    c, dt = token.split(":", 1)
                elif "=" in token:
                    c, dt = token.split("=", 1)
                else:
                    raise ValueError(f"cast(): invalid spec '{token}'. Expected 'col:type' or 'col=type'")
                target_map[_unquote_name(c.strip())] = _parse_dtype_spec(dt.strip().strip("'\""))
        elif isinstance(dtypes, Mapping):
            for c, dt in dtypes.items():
                target_map[_unquote_name(str(c))] = _parse_dtype_spec(dt)
        else:
            raise TypeError(f"cast(): dtypes must be a dict or string specification, got {type(dtypes)}")

    for c, dt in kwargs.items():
        target_map[_unquote_name(str(c))] = _parse_dtype_spec(dt)

    if not target_map:
        return df

    pl_df = _to_polars_frame(df)
    avail_cols = set(_df_columns(pl_df))
    for c in target_map:
        if c not in avail_cols:
            raise KeyError(f"column '{c}' not found in DataFrame for cast")

    return pl_df.cast(target_map, strict=strict)

################################################################################
# FILE: src/pytae/readers.py
################################################################################
"""Format-specific readers exposing a uniform metadata/inspection API.

Each reader avoids loading full row data for shape/columns/dtypes/head where
the file format allows it (parquet, sas7bdat carry that info in a header).
CSV/TXT have no embedded schema, so dtype inspection samples the first
DTYPE_SAMPLE_ROWS rows.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import io
import os
import re
import warnings
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd
import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.parquet as pa_parquet

from pytae.other_utilities import safe_reset_index

DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE = 200_000
CHUNK_SIZE = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE
DTYPE_SAMPLE_ROWS = 10_000


def _split_path_suffixes(path: Path) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
    """Return (base_suffix, compression) e.g. ('.csv', 'gzip') or ('.parquet', None)."""
    suffixes = [s.lower() for s in path.suffixes]
    if not suffixes:
        return ("", None)
    if suffixes[-1] == ".gz":
        base = suffixes[-2] if len(suffixes) >= 2 else ""
        return (base, "gzip")
    return (suffixes[-1], None)


def _delimited_dtypes(path: Path, *, sep: str, encoding: str | None, compression: str | None = None) -> pd.Series:
    return pd.read_csv(
        path, sep=sep, encoding=encoding, nrows=DTYPE_SAMPLE_ROWS, low_memory=False, compression=compression
    ).dtypes


def _print_progress(done: int, total: int | None, label: str) -> None:
    if total:
        pct = min(100, int(done * 100 / total))
        print(f"\r{label}... {done}/{total} rows ({pct}%)", end="", flush=True)
    else:
        print(f"\r{label}... {done} rows", end="", flush=True)


class ParquetReader:
    def __init__(self, path: Path, chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self._pf = pa_parquet.ParquetFile(path)

    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        md = self._pf.metadata
        return (md.num_rows, md.num_columns)

    def columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return list(self._pf.schema_arrow.names)

    def dtypes(self) -> pd.Series:
        return self._pf.schema_arrow.empty_table().to_pandas().dtypes

    def _empty(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return self._pf.schema_arrow.empty_table().to_pandas()

    def head(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if n <= 0 or self._pf.metadata.num_rows == 0:
            return self._empty()
        batch = next(self._pf.iter_batches(batch_size=n), None)
        if batch is None:
            return self._empty()
        return batch.to_pandas().head(n)

    def tail(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        total = self._pf.metadata.num_rows
        if n <= 0 or total == 0:
            return self._empty()
        skip = max(total - n, 0)
        parts, seen = [], 0
        for batch in self._pf.iter_batches(batch_size=max(n, 1)):
            start_in_batch = max(0, skip - seen)
            if start_in_batch < batch.num_rows:
                parts.append(batch.to_pandas().iloc[start_in_batch:])
            seen += batch.num_rows
        df = pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True) if parts else self._empty()
        return df.tail(n)

    def to_dataframe(
        self,
        columns: list[str] | None = None,
        progress: bool = False,
        nrows: int | None = None,
        chunk_size: int | None = None,
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if not progress and nrows is None:
            df = pd.read_parquet(self.path, columns=columns)
            if "_pt_by" in df.attrs:
                del df.attrs["_pt_by"]
            return df
        total = self._pf.metadata.num_rows
        limit = total if nrows is None else min(nrows, total)
        csize = chunk_size or self.chunk_size
        parts, done = [], 0
        for batch in self._pf.iter_batches(batch_size=csize, columns=columns):
            remaining = limit - done
            if remaining <= 0:
                break
            chunk = batch.to_pandas().iloc[:remaining]
            parts.append(chunk)
            done += len(chunk)
            if progress:
                _print_progress(done, limit, "reading")
        if progress:
            print()
        if parts:
            res = pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)
            if "_pt_by" in res.attrs:
                del res.attrs["_pt_by"]
            return res
        empty = self._empty()
        res = empty[columns] if columns else empty
        if "_pt_by" in res.attrs:
            del res.attrs["_pt_by"]
        return res

    def to_polars(self, columns: list[str] | None = None, nrows: int | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        return pl.read_parquet(self.path, columns=columns, n_rows=nrows)

    def to_polars_lazy(self, columns: list[str] | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        lf = pl.scan_parquet(self.path)
        if columns is not None:
            lf = lf.select(columns)
        return lf


class CsvReader:
    def __init__(
        self,
        path: Path,
        sep: str = ",",
        encoding: str | None = None,
        chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,
        compression: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self.sep = sep
        self.encoding = encoding
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.compression = compression

    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        n_cols = len(self.columns())
        total = 0
        for chunk in pd.read_csv(
            self.path,
            sep=self.sep,
            encoding=self.encoding,
            usecols=[0],
            chunksize=self.chunk_size,
            low_memory=False,
            compression=self.compression,
        ):
            total += len(chunk)
        return (total, n_cols)

    def columns(self) -> list[str]:
        try:
            return pd.read_csv(
                self.path,
                sep=self.sep,
                encoding=self.encoding,
                nrows=0,
                low_memory=False,
                compression=self.compression,
            ).columns.tolist()
        except pd.errors.EmptyDataError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"'{self.path.name}' is empty or not a valid CSV file") from exc

    def dtypes(self) -> pd.Series:
        return _delimited_dtypes(self.path, sep=self.sep, encoding=self.encoding, compression=self.compression)

    def head(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return pd.read_csv(
            self.path,
            sep=self.sep,
            encoding=self.encoding,
            nrows=n,
            low_memory=False,
            compression=self.compression,
        )

    def tail(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        total = self.shape()[0]
        skip = range(1, max(total - n, 0) + 1)  # keep the header (row 0), skip everything before the tail
        return pd.read_csv(
            self.path,
            sep=self.sep,
            encoding=self.encoding,
            skiprows=skip,
            low_memory=False,
            compression=self.compression,
        )

    def to_dataframe(
        self,
        columns: list[str] | None = None,
        progress: bool = False,
        nrows: int | None = None,
        chunk_size: int | None = None,
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if not progress:
            return pd.read_csv(
                self.path,
                sep=self.sep,
                encoding=self.encoding,
                usecols=columns,
                nrows=nrows,
                low_memory=False,
                compression=self.compression,
            )
        total = self.shape()[0] if nrows is None else min(nrows, self.shape()[0])
        chunks, done = [], 0
        csize = chunk_size or self.chunk_size
        reader = pd.read_csv(
            self.path,
            sep=self.sep,
            encoding=self.encoding,
            usecols=columns,
            chunksize=csize,
            nrows=nrows,
            low_memory=False,
            compression=self.compression,
        )
        for chunk in reader:
            chunks.append(chunk)
            done += len(chunk)
            _print_progress(done, total, "reading")
        print()
        return pd.concat(chunks, ignore_index=True) if chunks else pd.DataFrame(columns=columns or [])

    def to_polars(self, columns: list[str] | None = None, nrows: int | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        return pl.read_csv(
            self.path,
            separator=self.sep,
            columns=columns,
            n_rows=nrows,
            encoding=self.encoding or "utf8",
            null_values=["", '""', "NA", "NaN", "null", "None", "NULL", "nan", "n/a", "N/A", "<NA>"],
            truncate_ragged_lines=True,
        )

    def to_polars_lazy(self, columns: list[str] | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        lf = pl.scan_csv(
            self.path,
            separator=self.sep,
            encoding=self.encoding or "utf8",
            null_values=["", '""', "NA", "NaN", "null", "None", "NULL", "nan", "n/a", "N/A", "<NA>"],
            truncate_ragged_lines=True,
        )
        if columns is not None:
            lf = lf.select(columns)
        return lf


class TxtReader:
    """Reads delimited .txt/.dat files (tab-delimited for .txt, pipe-delimited for .dat by default)."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        path: Path,
        sep: str = "\t",
        encoding: str | None = None,
        chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,
        compression: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self.sep = sep
        self.encoding = encoding
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.compression = compression

    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        n_cols = len(self.columns())
        total = 0
        for chunk in pd.read_csv(
            self.path,
            sep=self.sep,
            encoding=self.encoding,
            usecols=[0],
            chunksize=self.chunk_size,
            low_memory=False,
            compression=self.compression,
        ):
            total += len(chunk)
        return (total, n_cols)

    def columns(self) -> list[str]:
        try:
            return pd.read_csv(
                self.path,
                sep=self.sep,
                encoding=self.encoding,
                nrows=0,
                low_memory=False,
                compression=self.compression,
            ).columns.tolist()
        except pd.errors.EmptyDataError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"'{self.path.name}' is empty or not a valid delimited file") from exc

    def dtypes(self) -> pd.Series:
        return _delimited_dtypes(self.path, sep=self.sep, encoding=self.encoding, compression=self.compression)

    def head(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return pd.read_csv(
            self.path,
            sep=self.sep,
            encoding=self.encoding,
            nrows=n,
            low_memory=False,
            compression=self.compression,
        )

    def tail(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        total = self.shape()[0]
        skip = range(1, max(total - n, 0) + 1)  # keep the header (row 0), skip everything before the tail
        return pd.read_csv(
            self.path,
            sep=self.sep,
            encoding=self.encoding,
            skiprows=skip,
            low_memory=False,
            compression=self.compression,
        )

    def to_dataframe(
        self,
        columns: list[str] | None = None,
        progress: bool = False,
        nrows: int | None = None,
        chunk_size: int | None = None,
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if not progress:
            return pd.read_csv(
                self.path,
                sep=self.sep,
                encoding=self.encoding,
                usecols=columns,
                nrows=nrows,
                low_memory=False,
                compression=self.compression,
            )
        total = self.shape()[0] if nrows is None else min(nrows, self.shape()[0])
        chunks, done = [], 0
        csize = chunk_size or self.chunk_size
        reader = pd.read_csv(
            self.path,
            sep=self.sep,
            encoding=self.encoding,
            usecols=columns,
            chunksize=csize,
            nrows=nrows,
            low_memory=False,
            compression=self.compression,
        )
        for chunk in reader:
            chunks.append(chunk)
            done += len(chunk)
            _print_progress(done, total, "reading")
        print()
        return pd.concat(chunks, ignore_index=True) if chunks else pd.DataFrame(columns=columns or [])

    def to_polars(self, columns: list[str] | None = None, nrows: int | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        return pl.read_csv(
            self.path,
            separator=self.sep,
            columns=columns,
            n_rows=nrows,
            encoding=self.encoding or "utf8",
            null_values=["", '""', "NA", "NaN", "null", "None", "NULL", "nan", "n/a", "N/A", "<NA>"],
            truncate_ragged_lines=True,
        )

    def to_polars_lazy(self, columns: list[str] | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        lf = pl.scan_csv(
            self.path,
            separator=self.sep,
            encoding=self.encoding or "utf8",
            null_values=["", '""', "NA", "NaN", "null", "None", "NULL", "nan", "n/a", "N/A", "<NA>"],
            truncate_ragged_lines=True,
        )
        if columns is not None:
            lf = lf.select(columns)
        return lf


class SasReader:
    """Reads .sas7bdat files. Row count/columns come from the file header,
    so shape/columns are cheap; dtype inspection reads a small sample."""

    def __init__(self, path: Path, encoding: str | None = None, chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self.encoding = "utf-8" if encoding is None else encoding
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size

    def _open(self):
        return pd.read_sas(self.path, format="sas7bdat", encoding=self.encoding, iterator=True)

    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        with self._open() as reader:
            return (reader.row_count, len(reader.column_names))

    def columns(self) -> list[str]:
        with self._open() as reader:
            return [str(name) for name in reader.column_names]

    def dtypes(self) -> pd.Series:
        with self._open() as reader:
            sample = reader.read(min(100, reader.row_count))
        return sample.dtypes

    def head(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        with self._open() as reader:
            return reader.read(n)

    def tail(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        with self._open() as reader:
            total = reader.row_count
            skip = max(total - n, 0)
            if skip:
                reader.read(skip)  # advance past rows we don't need
            return reader.read(min(n, total))

    def to_dataframe(
        self,
        columns: list[str] | None = None,
        progress: bool = False,
        nrows: int | None = None,
        chunk_size: int | None = None,
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if not progress and nrows is None:
            df = pd.read_sas(self.path, format="sas7bdat", encoding=self.encoding)
            return df[columns] if columns else df
        with self._open() as reader:
            total = reader.row_count if nrows is None else min(nrows, reader.row_count)
            chunks, done = [], 0
            csize = chunk_size or self.chunk_size
            while done < total:
                chunk = reader.read(min(csize, total - done))
                if chunk is None or len(chunk) == 0:
                    break
                chunks.append(chunk)
                done += len(chunk)
                if progress:
                    _print_progress(done, total, "reading")
        if progress:
            print()
        df = pd.concat(chunks, ignore_index=True) if chunks else pd.DataFrame()
        return df[columns] if columns else df

    def to_polars(self, columns: list[str] | None = None, nrows: int | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        return pl.from_pandas(self.to_dataframe(columns=columns, nrows=nrows))


class JsonlReader:
    """Reads line-delimited JSON (.jsonl / .ndjson) files."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        path: Path,
        chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,
        compression: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.compression = compression

    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        n_cols = len(self.columns())
        total = 0
        for chunk in pd.read_json(
            self.path,
            lines=True,
            chunksize=self.chunk_size,
            compression=self.compression,
        ):
            total += len(chunk)
        return (total, n_cols)

    def columns(self) -> list[str]:
        try:
            cols = pd.read_json(
                self.path,
                lines=True,
                nrows=1,
                compression=self.compression,
            ).columns.tolist()
            if not cols:
                raise ValueError(f"'{self.path.name}' is empty or not a valid JSON Lines file")
            return cols
        except Exception as exc:
            if isinstance(exc, ValueError) and "is empty or not a valid JSON Lines file" in str(exc):
                raise
            raise ValueError(f"'{self.path.name}' is empty or not a valid JSON Lines file") from exc

    def dtypes(self) -> pd.Series:
        return pd.read_json(
            self.path,
            lines=True,
            nrows=DTYPE_SAMPLE_ROWS,
            compression=self.compression,
        ).dtypes

    def head(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if n <= 0:
            return pd.DataFrame(columns=self.columns())
        return pd.read_json(
            self.path,
            lines=True,
            nrows=n,
            compression=self.compression,
        )

    def tail(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = self.to_dataframe()
        return df.tail(n)

    def to_dataframe(
        self,
        columns: list[str] | None = None,
        progress: bool = False,
        nrows: int | None = None,
        chunk_size: int | None = None,
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if not progress:
            df = pd.read_json(
                self.path,
                lines=True,
                nrows=nrows,
                compression=self.compression,
            )
            return df[columns] if columns else df
        total = self.shape()[0] if nrows is None else min(nrows, self.shape()[0])
        chunks, done = [], 0
        csize = chunk_size or self.chunk_size
        for chunk in pd.read_json(
            self.path,
            lines=True,
            chunksize=csize,
            nrows=nrows,
            compression=self.compression,
        ):
            chunks.append(chunk)
            done += len(chunk)
            _print_progress(done, total, "reading")
        print()
        df = pd.concat(chunks, ignore_index=True) if chunks else pd.DataFrame()
        return df[columns] if columns else df

    def to_polars(self, columns: list[str] | None = None, nrows: int | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        try:
            df = pl.read_ndjson(self.path)
            if nrows is not None:
                df = df.head(nrows)
            if columns is not None:
                df = df.select(columns)
            return df
        except Exception:
            return pl.from_pandas(self.to_dataframe(columns=columns, nrows=nrows))

    def to_polars_lazy(self, columns: list[str] | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        try:
            lf = pl.scan_ndjson(self.path)
            if columns is not None:
                lf = lf.select(columns)
            return lf
        except Exception:
            return self.to_polars(columns=columns).lazy()


class StdinReader:
    """Reader for data piped via STDIN, buffered in memory."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        data: bytes,
        *,
        fmt: str | None = None,
        sep: str | None = None,
        encoding: str | None = None,
        chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,
    ) -> None:
        self.data = data
        self.path = Path("<stdin>")
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.sep = sep
        self.encoding = encoding
        self.fmt = fmt
        self._df = self._load()

    def _load(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if not self.data:
            return pd.DataFrame()
        fmt = (self.fmt or "").lower().strip()
        if fmt in ("parquet", "pq") or (not fmt and self.data.startswith(b"PAR1")):
            return pd.read_parquet(io.BytesIO(self.data))
        if fmt in ("jsonl", "ndjson") or (not fmt and self.data.lstrip()[:1] in (b"{", b"[")):
            return pd.read_json(io.BytesIO(self.data), orient="records", lines=True)
        # Delimited text (CSV, TSV, etc.)
        sep = self.sep
        if sep is None:
            first_line = self.data.split(b"\n", 1)[0]
            if b"\t" in first_line and b"," not in first_line:
                sep = "\t"
            elif b"|" in first_line and b"," not in first_line:
                sep = "|"
            else:
                sep = ","
        compression = "gzip" if self.data.startswith(b"\x1f\x8b") else None
        return pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(self.data), sep=sep, encoding=self.encoding, compression=compression)

    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        return self._df.shape

    def columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return list(self._df.columns)

    def dtypes(self) -> pd.Series:
        return self._df.dtypes

    def head(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return self._df.head(n)

    def tail(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return self._df.tail(n)

    def to_dataframe(
        self,
        columns: list[str] | None = None,
        progress: bool = False,
        nrows: int | None = None,
        chunk_size: int | None = None,
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
        out = self._df
        if columns is not None:
            out = out[columns]
        if nrows is not None:
            out = out.iloc[:nrows]
        return out

    def to_polars(self, columns: list[str] | None = None, nrows: int | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        return pl.from_pandas(self.to_dataframe(columns=columns, nrows=nrows))

    def to_polars_lazy(self, columns: list[str] | None = None):
        return self.to_polars(columns=columns).lazy()


class DataFrameReader:
    """Reader wrapping an in-memory DataFrame (e.g. from clipboard or memory)."""

    def __init__(self, df: pd.DataFrame, path: Path | str = "<dataframe>") -> None:
        self._df = df
        self.path = Path(str(path))

    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        return self._df.shape

    def columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return list(self._df.columns)

    def dtypes(self) -> pd.Series:
        return self._df.dtypes

    def head(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return self._df.head(n)

    def tail(self, n: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return self._df.tail(n)

    def to_dataframe(
        self,
        columns: list[str] | None = None,
        progress: bool = False,
        nrows: int | None = None,
        chunk_size: int | None = None,
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
        out = self._df
        if columns is not None:
            out = out[columns]
        if nrows is not None:
            out = out.iloc[:nrows]
        return out

    def to_polars(self, columns: list[str] | None = None, nrows: int | None = None):
        import polars as pl

        df = pl.from_pandas(self._df)
        if nrows is not None:
            df = df.head(nrows)
        if columns is not None:
            df = df.select(columns)
        return df

    def to_polars_lazy(self, columns: list[str] | None = None):
        return self.to_polars(columns=columns).lazy()


_READERS = {
    ".parquet": ParquetReader,
    ".pq": ParquetReader,
    ".csv": CsvReader,
    ".txt": TxtReader,
    ".dat": TxtReader,
    ".sas7bdat": SasReader,
    ".jsonl": JsonlReader,
    ".ndjson": JsonlReader,
}

# YAML connection configs (Databricks / SSH) are handled by the isolated pytae.connections
# module, loaded lazily so the core package never imports its optional dependencies.
_YAML_SUFFIXES = (".yaml", ".yml")
_EXTERNAL_CONNECTIONS_MODULE = None

# default field separator for TxtReader-backed suffixes (.txt/.dat)
_TXT_DEFAULT_SEP = {".txt": "\t", ".dat": "|"}

# default text encoding for TxtReader-backed suffixes; only .dat has one (.txt still
# falls through to pandas' own encoding inference, i.e. None)
_TXT_DEFAULT_ENCODING = {".dat": "latin-1"}


def get_reader(
    path: Path, *, sep: str | None = None, encoding: str | None = None, chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE
):
    suffix, compression = _split_path_suffixes(path)
    if suffix in _YAML_SUFFIXES:
        global _EXTERNAL_CONNECTIONS_MODULE
        if _EXTERNAL_CONNECTIONS_MODULE is None:
            conn_env = os.environ.get("PYTAE_CONNECTIONS_PATH")
            if not conn_env:
                raise FileNotFoundError(
                    "connection reader not configured; set the PYTAE_CONNECTIONS_PATH environment "
                    "variable to a connections.py file"
                )
            module_path = Path(conn_env).expanduser()
            if not module_path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(
                    "connection reader not found; set PYTAE_CONNECTIONS_PATH to a connections.py file "
                    f"(looked for '{module_path}')"
                )
            module_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_pytae_external_connections", module_path)
            if module_spec is None or module_spec.loader is None:
                raise ImportError(f"cannot load connections module from '{module_path}'")
            _EXTERNAL_CONNECTIONS_MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(module_spec)
            module_spec.loader.exec_module(_EXTERNAL_CONNECTIONS_MODULE)
        return _EXTERNAL_CONNECTIONS_MODULE.build_yaml_reader(path)
    try:
        cls = _READERS[suffix]
    except KeyError:
        supported = ", ".join(
            sorted((*_READERS, *_YAML_SUFFIXES, ".csv.gz", ".txt.gz", ".dat.gz", ".jsonl.gz", ".ndjson.gz"))
        )
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported file type '{path.suffix or path.name}'; supported: {supported}") from None
    if cls is CsvReader:
        return CsvReader(path, sep=sep or ",", encoding=encoding, chunk_size=chunk_size, compression=compression)
    if cls is TxtReader:
        return TxtReader(
            path,
            sep=sep or _TXT_DEFAULT_SEP[suffix],
            encoding=encoding or _TXT_DEFAULT_ENCODING.get(suffix),
            chunk_size=chunk_size,
            compression=compression,
        )
    if cls is JsonlReader:
        return JsonlReader(path, chunk_size=chunk_size, compression=compression)
    if cls is SasReader:
        return SasReader(path, encoding=encoding, chunk_size=chunk_size)
    return cls(path, chunk_size=chunk_size)


# .sas7bdat is intentionally excluded: pandas has no writer for that format.
_WRITABLE_SUFFIXES = (
    ".parquet",
    ".pq",
    ".csv",
    ".txt",
    ".dat",
    ".jsonl",
    ".ndjson",
    ".csv.gz",
    ".txt.gz",
    ".dat.gz",
    ".jsonl.gz",
    ".ndjson.gz",
)


def write_dataframe(
    df: Any,
    dest: Path,
    *,
    sep: str | None = None,
    encoding: str | None = None,
    progress: bool = False,
    chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,
    index: bool | None = None,
) -> None:
    import polars as pl

    if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
        suffix, compression = _split_path_suffixes(dest)
        if progress or (encoding is not None and encoding.lower() not in ("utf-8", "utf8")):
            df = df.to_pandas()
        else:
            if suffix in (".parquet", ".pq"):
                df.write_parquet(dest)
                return
            elif suffix == ".csv":
                df.write_csv(
                    dest,
                    separator=sep or ",",
                    compression="gzip" if compression == "gzip" else "uncompressed",
                )
                return
            elif suffix in _TXT_DEFAULT_SEP:
                df.write_csv(
                    dest,
                    separator=sep or _TXT_DEFAULT_SEP[suffix],
                    compression="gzip" if compression == "gzip" else "uncompressed",
                )
                return
            elif suffix in (".jsonl", ".ndjson"):
                if compression is None:
                    df.write_ndjson(dest)
                    return
                else:
                    df = df.to_pandas()
            else:
                supported = ", ".join(_WRITABLE_SUFFIXES)
                raise ValueError(f"unsupported output type '{suffix or dest.name}'; supported: {supported}")

    if hasattr(df, "attrs") and "_pt_by" in df.attrs:
        df = df.copy(deep=False)
        df.attrs = {k: v for k, v in df.attrs.items() if k != "_pt_by"}
    if index is None:
        index = not (isinstance(getattr(df, "index", None), pd.RangeIndex) and getattr(df.index, "name", None) is None)
    suffix, compression = _split_path_suffixes(dest)
    if suffix in (".parquet", ".pq"):
        _write_parquet(df, dest, progress=progress, chunk_size=chunk_size, index=index)
    elif suffix == ".csv":
        _write_delimited(
            df,
            dest,
            sep=sep or ",",
            encoding=encoding,
            progress=progress,
            chunk_size=chunk_size,
            index=index,
            compression=compression,
        )
    elif suffix in _TXT_DEFAULT_SEP:
        _write_delimited(
            df,
            dest,
            sep=sep or _TXT_DEFAULT_SEP[suffix],
            encoding=encoding or _TXT_DEFAULT_ENCODING.get(suffix),
            progress=progress,
            chunk_size=chunk_size,
            index=index,
            compression=compression,
        )
    elif suffix in (".jsonl", ".ndjson"):
        _write_jsonl(df, dest, progress=progress, chunk_size=chunk_size, compression=compression)
    else:
        supported = ", ".join(_WRITABLE_SUFFIXES)
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported output type '{suffix or dest.name}'; supported: {supported}")


def _write_delimited(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    dest: Path,
    *,
    sep: str,
    encoding: str | None,
    progress: bool,
    chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,
    index: bool = False,
    compression: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    total = len(df)
    if not progress or total == 0:
        df.to_csv(dest, sep=sep, encoding=encoding, index=index, compression=compression)
        return
    done = 0
    for start in range(0, total, chunk_size):
        chunk = df.iloc[start : start + chunk_size]
        chunk.to_csv(
            dest,
            sep=sep,
            encoding=encoding,
            index=index,
            mode="w" if start == 0 else "a",
            header=(start == 0),
            compression=compression,
        )
        done += len(chunk)
        _print_progress(done, total, "writing")
    print()


def _write_jsonl(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    dest: Path,
    *,
    progress: bool,
    chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,
    compression: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    df = safe_reset_index(df)
    total = len(df)
    if not progress or total == 0:
        df.to_json(dest, orient="records", lines=True, compression=compression)
        return
    done = 0
    for start in range(0, total, chunk_size):
        chunk = df.iloc[start : start + chunk_size]
        chunk.to_json(
            dest,
            orient="records",
            lines=True,
            mode="w" if start == 0 else "a",
            compression=compression,
        )
        done += len(chunk)
        _print_progress(done, total, "writing")
    print()


def _coerce_failing_parquet_column(df: pd.DataFrame, error_msg: str) -> str | None:
    match = re.search(r"Conversion failed for column (.+?) with type object", error_msg)
    if match:
        bad_col = match.group(1).strip()
        if bad_col in df.columns:
            df[bad_col] = df[bad_col].map(lambda v: str(v) if pd.notna(v) else None)
            warnings.warn(
                f"Column '{bad_col}' contained mixed object types; coerced to string for Parquet serialization.",
                UserWarning,
                stacklevel=3,
            )
            return bad_col
    return None


def _write_parquet(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    dest: Path,
    *,
    progress: bool,
    chunk_size: int = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,
    index: bool = False,
) -> None:
    df_to_write = df
